summary: Banco Latinoamericano de Comercio Exterior (Bladex) filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, signed by CFO Annette van Hoorde de Sol on November 12, 2026. Total assets rose to $16.48B from $12.79B at year-end 2025, loans grew to $12.32B from $9.14B, and equity reached $1.79B. No transaction, stakeholder action, or structural event is disclosed; this is ordinary periodic reporting for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US quarterly earnings filing.
